summary: Lower the builtin queueMicrotask host API to the same microtask queue used by Promise reactions.

target.notes: Enqueue after the current stack/task unwinds and before the next task; callback exceptions are host-reported exceptions rather than Promise rejections.

semantics.ordering: FIFO with Promise jobs in the same host microtask queue

caveats: Task.Run and ThreadPool scheduling do not preserve microtask ordering.
A recursive microtask chain can starve later tasks.

tests.name: shares ordering with Promise reaction
tests.expected_behavior: prints p then q when enqueued in that order
